text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angola's state-owned oil company Sonangol said it had extracted 5.8 million barrels of oil in four years on its four concessions in the northern off-shore block off the country.
- Algerian Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, on an official visit to Angola, said he hoped the two countries would strengthen bilateral ties and cooperation on petroleum, commerce and health.
- UNITA fomer rebels dismantled two military control posts they had set up on the main road between Huila and Huambo provinces, the United Nations said.
- U.N. special envoy to Angola Alioune Blondin Beye would return to the country next week after a holiday, officials said.
- Angola's national assembly postponed indefinitely its discussion on the state budget, which was to have taken place on Wednesday.
